recentItems.title: Jonathan Fink @SiliconCurtain: This is regime final phase! Ukraine burned refinery on election day
recentItems.description:
Russian high-ranking officials and even military enlistment office staff are massively evacuating their families and capital abroad, which, according to Jonathan Fink, founder of the Silicon Curtain channel, indicates that the Kremlin system has entered the final phase of collapse.

The crisis is being deepened by successful actions of Ukraine’s defense forces: a combined strike disabled the Moscow Oil Refinery in Kapotnya on election night (after which even Donald Trump acknowledged the collapse of Russia’s diesel sector), while fighters of the Third Army Corps, in information silence, carried out Operation “Vivaldi,” cutting off the enemy’s offensive pincers near Lyman.

Against the backdrop of military defeats and the threat of 100% tariffs on oil exports under the Graham Act, Moscow is resorting to desperate provocations against NATO — from violating Polish airspace to drone incidents in Leipzig and preparing sabotage operations in Europe.

recentItems.title: 173 DRONES IN ONE NIGHT: RUSSIA LAUNCHED 50+ JET-POWERED UAVs AND GUIDED BOMBS!
recentItems.description:
During the night into Saturday, the Russian military launched 173 attack drones at Ukraine, including more than 50 high-speed jet-powered UAVs. Ukraine’s Defense Forces neutralized 134 targets, but impacts were recorded at 19 locations.

At the same time, Russian forces struck residential buildings and civilian infrastructure in Sumy with three guided aerial bombs, killing two people and injuring at least seven others. In addition, the enemy continues its round-the-clock drone terror campaign against Kyiv and its suburbs, deliberately targeting residential neighborhoods, apartment buildings, shops and offices.

recentItems.title: MOSCOW IN BLACKOUT, CRIMEA WITHOUT POWER AND WATER: strikes on TPP-22 and oil refinery!
recentItems.description:
In northern Donetsk region, during Operation “Vivaldi,” fighters of the 3rd Army Corps eliminated over 3,000 occupiers, cut off the “Lyman pincers,” and regained control of 125 sq. km of territory, including Drobysheve.

In parallel, hundreds of Ukrainian drones and new-generation missiles (“Flamingo,” “Pelican,” “Vendetta”) struck Moscow, hitting oil refinery units, Thermal Power Plant №22, and mega-warehouses in Sofino covering 290,000 sq. m. In Crimea, defense forces’ operations destroyed nearly 400 energy facilities and 285 vessels, paralyzing the peninsula’s logistics.

Against the backdrop of these successes, Western allies are significantly strengthening the protection of Ukraine’s skies: the US approved a $2.7 billion air defense package, while Denmark allocated $275 million. At the same time, Ukraine has begun using drones to intercept enemy jet-powered UAVs, while European intelligence services warn of the risk of Kremlin armed provocations against NATO countries.

recentItems.title: UKRAINIAN KNOCK OUT 7 MILLION TONS OF RUSSIAN OIL! Enemy drones hit residential building in Kyiv!
recentItems.description:
Overnight, Ukraine’s defense forces struck the strategic Ilsky oil refinery in Russia’s Krasnodar Krai, which has a capacity of 7 million tons of oil per year, causing a major fire and disrupting the occupiers’ fuel logistics in the south.

In response, Russian forces launched drone attacks on Kyiv, where a hit on a residential high-rise building injured five people. They also struck a highway in Odesa region, damaging three trucks (one burned down) and injuring three civilians.
